name: crux-trip-package-pricing
description: Price multi-day trips and packages from their costs, and compare marketplace commission with direct booking fees.

interface.longDescription:
Price a retreat, training camp, surf or dive trip, fishing or hunting package, or any multi-day trip from its costs.

Tell ChatGPT the nights, the number of guests and what the trip costs you (venue or rooms, food, guides or teachers, activities and other costs). You get the break-even per guest, a suggested price that covers your costs, booking and card fees and the profit you want, separate prices for room types such as shared and private, a deposit per guest, your profit when the trip is full and when some spots stay empty, and how many guests you need to break even.

You can also compare a season's booking fees two ways: a booking marketplace's commission, or booking direct with a platform fee plus card processing.

Works in any currency. Card fees are estimates and vary by country. The app only calculates: it doesn't store what you enter and doesn't need an account.
defaultPrompt: Help me price my retreat from its costs

positive.description: Prices a retreat from its costs
positive.prompt: I'm running a 7-night yoga retreat for 12 guests. The villa is $9,000 for the week, food is $35 per person per day and I pay two teachers $1,500 each. What should I charge per person?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip_package_pricing with nights 7, guests 12, accommodationTotal 9000, foodPerGuestPerDay 35, staffTotal 3000. Answer: suggested price $1,750 per guest, break-even $1,245 per guest, 30% deposit $525, breaks even at 9 of 12 guests, and a loss at 70% full.

positive.description: Prices shared and private room types
positive.prompt: Price a 5-night surf camp with 6 shared and 4 private spots; private should cost 40% more. The house is $400 a night, food $25 a day per person and coaching $1,200 in total.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip_package_pricing with nights 5, accommodationPerNight 400, foodPerGuestPerDay 25, staffTotal 1200 and roomTypes Shared (6 guests) and Private (4 guests, premiumPercent 40). Answer: Shared $535 and Private $745 per guest, break-even $445 per guest.

positive.description: Works in another currency with a custom profit target
positive.prompt: Plan pricing in THB for a 10-night Muay Thai camp for 15 fighters: rooms 6,000 baht a night, food 400 baht per person per day, trainers 60,000 baht. I want 25% profit.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip_package_pricing with currency THB, nights 10, guests 15, accommodationPerNight 6000, foodPerGuestPerDay 400, staffTotal 60000, targetProfitPercent 25. Answer in baht: suggested price ฿18,000 per guest, break-even ฿12,000 per guest.

positive.description: Compares marketplace commission with booking direct
positive.prompt: We take 60 bookings a season averaging $2,400. What does a 15% marketplace commission cost us compared with booking direct?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_booking_costs with bookingsPerSeason 60, averageBookingValue 2400, marketplaceCommissionPercent 15. Answer: marketplace $21,600, direct about $11,394 (5% platform fee plus estimated card fees), booking direct keeps about $10,206 more per season.

positive.description: Gives a break-even and price for a fishing package
positive.prompt: Our fishing lodge has 8 angler spots for a 3-night package. Guiding costs $3,000, the lodge is $250 a night and food is $60 a day per angler. What's our break-even and a good price?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip_package_pricing with nights 3, guests 8, staffTotal 3000, accommodationPerNight 250, foodPerGuestPerDay 60. Answer: break-even about $649 per angler, suggested price $900, breaks even at 6 of 8 anglers.

negative.description: Unrelated request: weather. The app shouldn't run; ChatGPT answers normally.
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Bali next week?

negative.description: Booking a trip as a traveller. The app calculates prices for operators and can't search or book trips; ChatGPT should answer without it or explain it can't book.
negative.prompt: Book me a spot at a surf camp in Costa Rica for the first week of May.

negative.description: Real estate pricing is outside the app's purpose (multi-day trips and packages). The app shouldn't run.
negative.prompt: How much should I list my 3-bedroom house for?

publication.release_notes: First release: price a multi-day trip or package from its costs (break-even, suggested price, room types, deposit, profit when full and at 70%, guests to break even), and compare marketplace commission with direct booking fees.
